Zorko Group · Food-business formats

Food-business formats.
Find the fit before the format.

Exploring a pizza, burger, sandwich, chaat, waffle or café business? Compare the customer, premises and operating requirements before choosing an opportunity.

Menu category and franchise model are different

A food category on a menu does not automatically establish a separate franchise offering. Explore Zorko’s brand network and confirm which brands and formats are currently available with the team.

Consider who you intend to serve, the location, seating or takeaway needs, equipment, staffing and supply requirements. Compare the whole operation rather than choosing only a popular dish.

Questions for a fast-food business

  • Which menu categories are included in the actual offer?
  • What space, equipment and utilities does the format require?
  • How are recipes, training and supplies coordinated?
  • What responsibilities remain with the owner?
  • How will the model work for local customer demand?

Looking for food rather than a business?

For current menu and outlet information, visit the Zorko food-brand website. Our corporate office is a business and workplace destination; it is not presented as a restaurant location.

Compare pizza, burger, sandwich, chaat and waffle formats

For a pizza franchise, ask about oven capacity and prep time. When comparing burger and sandwich franchises, check how peak-hour assembly and ingredient storage work. For a chaat or waffle franchise, discuss the equipment, batch sizes and how long products hold their quality for takeaway. For a café franchise in India, consider seating, staffing and customer demand alongside the menu.

Looking for somewhere to eat? Browse the official Zorko vegetarian menu or explore the group’s food brands for current consumer information.
